23:75.text: And though We had mercy on them and removed the distress which is on them, still they would obstinately persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.

23:76.text: And indeed We seized them with punishment, but they humbled not themselves to their Lord, nor did they invoke

23:77.text: Until, when We open for them the gate of severe punishment, then lo! they will be plunged into destruction with deep regrets, sorrows and in despair.

23:78.text: It is He Who has created for you

23:79.text: And it is He Who has created you on the earth, and to Him you shall be gathered back.

23:80.text: And it is He Who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of night and day. Will you not then understand?

23:81.text: Nay, but they say the like of what the men of old said.

23:82.text: They said: "When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected indeed?

23:83.text: "Verily, this we have been promised - we and our fathers before
! This is only the tales of the ancients!"

23:84.text: Say: "Whose is the earth and whosoever is therein? If you know!"

23:85.text: They will say: "It is Allâh’s!" Say: "Will you not then remember?"

23:86.text: Lord of the seven heavens, and

23:87.text: They will say: "Allâh." Say: "Will you not then fear Allâh
(believe in His Oneness, obey Him, believe in the Resurrection and Recompense for every good or bad deed)

23:88.text: Say "In Whose Hand is the sovereignty of everything
, while against Whom there is no protector,
(i.e. if Allâh saves anyone none can punish or harm him, and if Allâh punishes or harms anyone none can save him)

23:89.text: to Allâh." Say: "How then are you deceived and turn away from the truth?"
